defects.problem: Link panel is a cropped slice of the app: 'I checked this picture' is sliced at the top edge and the Copy link / Delete now buttons are sliced through their labels at the bottom edge. Reads as a bad crop, not a designed window.
defects.fix: Re-frame the crop so the panel starts below the previous row and ends below the buttons, using the existing recording region; no zoom, just a different fixed window.

defects.problem: Phone clip is cropped by its own device frame: left edge shows 'ep 1 of', 'ap the Cancel subsc', 'utton at the bottom', and 'Previous step' / 'Ne' buttons are cut at both sides. The footage does not fit the bezel.
defects.fix: Fit the full phone screen width inside the bezel (letterbox rather than fill) so the instruction text and Next button are whole.

defects.problem: Final phone beat is the Photos original: mostly black screen with 'Crop', 'Today 4:06 AM' chrome and a tiny billing page with right edge cut off. At feed size the content is unreadable and the black band looks dead. A red recording dot is also visible in the earlier status bar.
defects.fix: Hold the highlighted-step frame through the end, or scale the Photos clip to fill the bezel width without clipping; trim the recording-dot frames.

defects.problem: First frame is a dissolve from the previous section: ghosted panel, 'Box overlap 0.89, needs 0.5' caption and a stray cursor overlap the new layout.
defects.fix: Shorten the dissolve or start this section on a clean frame.

defects.at: all phone frames at feed size
defects.problem: Phone is about a quarter of the width; the highlight and Cancel label are only just readable and the left synthetic screen text is too small to read.
defects.fix: Give the phone a larger share of the layout at feed size, using layout only.

defects.problem: Right-hand 'Send a seven-day link' heading duplicates the lower caption 'Send a seven-day link.', and the left column is crowded while the right is empty.
defects.fix: Drop one of the two, or move the heading to fill the space.

couldNotAssess: Motion smoothness and easing of dissolves
Whether the muted read works as a sequence in real time at 5.6 s
oneLineVerdict: Good idea and honest labelling, but both the link panel and the phone footage are visibly clipped at their edges, and the Photos finale is a near-black unreadable frame at feed size.
